items.source: Spring joined the MCP ecosystem early as a key contributor, helping to develop and maintain the official MCP Java SDK that serves as the foundation for Java-based MCP implementations. Building on this contribution, Spring AI provides MCP support through Boot Starters and annotations, making it easy to build both MCP servers and clients.
items.translation: Spring 作为早期核心贡献者加入了 MCP 生态系统，协助开发和维护作为 Java 基础 MCP 实现基石的 官方 MCP Java SDK。 基于这一贡献，Spring AI 通过 Boot Starters 和注解提供 MCP 支持，使构建 MCP 服务端和客户端变得更加简单。

items.source: Beyond the tutorial examples, the Spring AI Examples repository contains numerous MCP implementations.
items.translation: 除了教程示例之外，Spring AI Examples 仓库还包含大量的 MCP 实现。
